title: An optimised protocol for the expression and purification of adenovirus core protein VII.
authors: Athukorala, Ajani; Helbig, Karla J; McSharry, Brian P; Forwood, Jade K; Sarker, Subir
one_liner_zh: 该文优化腺病毒核心蛋白VII的表达纯化方案，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作背景，但无AI/物理模拟方法，且未聚焦TF-DNA结合建模，仅为基础实验方法学。
abstract: Adenovirus protein VII (pVII) is a highly basic core protein, bearing resemblance to mammalian histones. Despite its diverse functions, a comprehensive understanding of its structural intricacies and the mechanisms underlying its functions remain elusive, primarily due to the complexity of producing a good amount of soluble pVII. This study aimed to optimise the expression and purification of recombinant pVII from four different adenoviruses with a simple vector construct. This study successfully determined the optimal conditions for efficiently purifying pVII across four adenovirus species, revealing the differential preference for bacterial expression systems. The One Shot BL21 Star (DE3) proved favourable over Rosetta 2 (DE3) pLysS with consistent levels of expression between IPTG-induced and auto-induction. We demonstrated that combining chemical and mechanical cell lysis is possible and highly effective. Other noteworthy benefits were observed in using RNase during sample processing. The addition of RNase has significantly improved the quality and quantity of the purified protein as confirmed by chromatographic and western blot analyses. These findings established a solid groundwork for pVII purification methodologies and carry the significant potential to assist in unveiling the core structure of pVII, its arrangement within the core, DNA condensation intricacies, and potential pathways for nuclear transport.
abstract_zh: 腺病毒蛋白VII（pVII）是一种高度碱性的核心蛋白，与哺乳动物组蛋白相似。尽管其功能多样，但由于难以生产足量可溶性pVII，对其结构细节及其功能机制的全面理解仍难以实现。本研究旨在通过简单的载体构建，优化来自四种不同腺病毒的重组pVII的表达与纯化。本研究成功确定了高效纯化四种腺病毒物种pVII的最佳条件，揭示了对细菌表达系统的差异性偏好。One Shot BL21 Star (DE3) 被证明优于Rosetta 2 (DE3) pLysS，在IPTG诱导和自诱导之间表达水平一致。我们证明了化学裂解与机械裂解相结合是可行且高效的。在样品处理过程中使用RNase还观察到其他显著益处。添加RNase显著提高了纯化蛋白的质量和数量，这一点通过色谱分析和Western blot分析得到证实。这些发现为pVII纯化方法奠定了坚实基础，并具有巨大潜力，有助于揭示pVII的核心结构、其在核心内的排列、DNA凝聚的复杂性以及核转运的潜在途径。
